rows.title: API Scrape & Restarts
rows.description: Scrape status comes from Prometheus (1 = the API answered the last scrape, 0 = it did not). Restarts count changes of the API process start time in the last hour; there is no container exporter.

rows.title: PostgreSQL & Ledger Health
rows.description: 1 = available, 0 = unavailable. PostgreSQL is a short read-only SELECT 1; ledger readable means marker, ledger and journal can be read, not that storage is writable or durable. When the accounting snapshot is 0, budget balances are omitted instead of shown as zero.

rows.title: CPU Usage (%)
rows.description: VPS CPU in use, from node_exporter.

rows.title: RAM Usage (%)
rows.description: VPS memory in use, from node_exporter.

rows.title: Disk Usage (%)
rows.description: VPS filesystem space in use, from node_exporter.

rows.title: Node Exporter Status
rows.description: Prometheus scrape status of node_exporter: 1 = up, 0 = down. The VPS panels above have no data while it is down.

rows.title: API Requests per Second
rows.description: HTTP requests per second by method and route, averaged over 5 minutes. The Prometheus /metrics scrape is excluded.

rows.title: HTTP 5xx Error Rate
rows.description: Share of HTTP responses with a 5xx status over 5 minutes (0-100%). 0% means traffic without server errors; with no traffic at all there is no rate sample, so the panel shows No data rather than 0%.

rows.title: API Latency (p50/p95)
rows.description: HTTP response time, including sending the response: median (p50) and 95th percentile (p95) over 5 minutes. The /metrics scrape is excluded.

rows.title: Analysis Requests & Outcomes
rows.description: Two different events. Admission = the HTTP answer to an Analyze Fit request (accepted, duplicate, refused, failure); accepted does not mean completed. Execution = how the asynchronous run actually ended (completed, held, failed, refused, unknown). Rates per second over 5 minutes; No data until an analysis runs.

rows.title: AI Stage Latency (p95)
rows.description: 95th percentile wall time per pipeline stage over 5 minutes. Stages are nested, so do not add them up. A cached JD extraction creates no extraction timing. No data until a live analysis runs (live AI is off); missing data is not zero.

rows.title: AI Stage Outcomes
rows.description: Executed pipeline stages per second by outcome, over 5 minutes. No data until a live analysis runs (live AI is off); missing data is not zero.

rows.title: LLM Attempts & Errors
rows.description: LLM attempts in the last hour after their ledger line is durable, by model, attempt kind and outcome; failed provider attempts count. Unledgered intents appear under accounting uncertainty, not here. No data until a live LLM call happens.

rows.title: LLM Call Latency (p95)
rows.description: 95th percentile latency of recorded LLM attempts per model, over 5 minutes. No data until a live LLM call happens.

rows.title: LLM Token Usage
rows.description: Tokens in the last hour by model and direction, only for attempts where the provider reported usage. Missing usage is not zero tokens.

rows.title: LLM Retries & Fallbacks
rows.description: Validation-repair and length-continuation retries, and fallback-model attempts, in the last hour. No data until a live LLM call happens.

rows.title: Budget Remaining & Liability
rows.description: Persisted budget state from the ledger and PostgreSQL (authoritative). Daily liability includes open reservations and a conservative midnight carryover; lifetime remaining also subtracts open reservations. Omitted, not zero, when the accounting snapshot is unavailable.

rows.title: Persisted Spending & Uncertainty
rows.description: Persisted cost views of the same spending; they overlap, so do not add them. Settled in DB includes conservative settlements, not only provider-confirmed bills.

match.managed: Attempt estimated upper bound vs accounted costs

rows.title: Estimated vs Accounted Cost
rows.description: Per-process observations in the last hour: reserved upper-bound estimates (not bills) and accounted cost by source. Counters reset on restart; use the persisted panels for balances. No data until a live LLM call happens.

rows.title: Ledger Evidence Bytes
rows.description: Size of the production usage ledger evidence. 0 bytes means an initialized, still-empty ledger.

rows.title: Budget Refusals
rows.description: Runtime refusals in the last hour because the daily (budget) or lifetime limit would be exceeded. No data until a refusal happens; that is not an error.
